# Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — Outcome Memo
**As of January 1, 2028**

**Result: Passed.** In the certified four-cohort read, unsupported-condition route-outs fell from 38/344 Helio Start eligibility-flow starts (11.0%) in control to 25/352 (7.1%) in treatment—a 35.7% relative reduction, exceeding the predeclared ≥25% path-quality threshold. The favorable direction held across all three weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort; no concurrent pricing-page layout or UI change was made.

**Guardrails: Both passed.** Eligible-workspace admission completion was 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment, a 0.3-point increase (within the maximum permitted 1.5-point decline). Account-level support time at the 90th percentile was 71 versus 74 minutes, a 3-minute increase (within the maximum permitted 10-minute increase).

**Rollout supported and completed.** The result supported adopting separate entry paths for bounded Helio Start and assisted needs on the organic pricing page. Priya approved the design as the default organic experience on November 25, 2025; Daniela moved it to 100% of organic traffic and retired control on November 26. Post-rollout checks confirmed existing path-selection, eligibility, admission, and support-routing events continued to populate without a taxonomy change.

**Boundaries unchanged.** Helio Start remains bounded to its existing under-50, simple-deployment path. Eligibility, refusal, connector-access, external-authority, lifecycle, instrumentation, and assisted support-routing rules did not change. This was an organic pricing-page result; it did not authorize paid traffic or alter acquisition boundaries.

**What this does not establish.** The test is evidence of fewer unsupported self-serve starts and improved pricing-page funnel quality. It does not establish revenue lift, paid-acquisition economics, acquisition performance, pipeline impact or a pipeline target, forecast credit, or a change in Helio Start eligibility.
